# @axiom-lattice/cli-a2a

Multi-provider A2A (Agent-to-Agent) CLI gateway. Wraps local coding agents
(OpenCode, Codex, Claude Code) as spec-compliant A2A servers. Drop a JSON
config, get a fully spec-compliant A2A agent — launchable via `npx`.

## Quick Start

```bash
# 1. Start your local OpenCode server
opencode serve

# 2. Launch the A2A gateway
npx @axiom-lattice/cli-a2a --provider opencode --port 3000

# 3. Verify
curl http://localhost:3000/health
# → { "status": "healthy", "agent": "CLI A2A Agent", "provider": "opencode" }

curl http://localhost:3000/.well-known/agent-card.json
# → A2A v0.3 AgentCard JSON
```

## Providers

| Provider | Status | Connection |
|----------|--------|------------|
| `opencode` | ✅ Ready | HTTP API (`opencode serve`) |
| `codex` | ✅ Ready | CLI subprocess (`codex`) |
| `claude` | ✅ Ready | CLI subprocess (`claude -p`) |

## Usage

```bash
npx @axiom-lattice/cli-a2a [options]
```

### Options

```
  --provider <name>            Provider: opencode | codex | claude
  --config, -c <path>          Path to agent JSON config file
  --port, -p <number>          A2A server port (default: 3000)
  --hostname <addr>            Bind address (default: 0.0.0.0)
  --advertise-host <host>      Hostname for agent card URLs
  --agent-name <name>          Agent display name
  --agent-description <desc>   Agent description
  --log-level <level>          debug | info | warn | error (default: info)
```

### OpenCode Options

```
  --opencode-url <url>         OpenCode server URL (default: http://localhost:4096)
  --directory, -d <path>       Project directory
  --model, -m <provider/model> LLM model
  --agent <name>               OpenCode agent preset
```

### Codex Options

```
  --codex-model <model>        Codex model ID (e.g. gpt-4o)
  --codex-api-key <key>        OpenAI API key
```

### Claude Code Options

```
  --claude-model <model>       Claude Code model ID
  --claude-api-key <key>       Anthropic API key
```

### Gateway Registration

The CLI can auto-register with an `@axiom-lattice/gateway` server so the
gateway discovers and routes to it as a first-class remote agent.

```
  --register-url <url>         Gateway URL to register this agent with
  --register-key <key>         API key for gateway authentication
  --unregister-on-shutdown     Remove agent from gateway on exit
```

```bash
npx @axiom-lattice/cli-a2a \
  --provider opencode \
  --port 3001 \
  --register-url http://gateway:8080 \
  --register-key sk-a2a-gateway-key \
  --unregister-on-shutdown &
```

On startup the CLI POSTs to `{registerUrl}/api/assistants` with a
`graphDefinition` of type `a2a_remote` pointing to its own agent card.
On exit (if `--unregister-on-shutdown`) it DELETEs the assistant.

After registration the agent appears alongside all other agents in the
gateway and can be invoked via the standard `/api/runs` endpoint.

## Configuration File

```json
{
  "provider": "opencode",
  "agentCard": {
    "name": "My Coding Agent",
    "description": "A coding assistant powered by OpenCode",
    "skills": [
      {
        "id": "code-gen",
        "name": "Code Generation",
        "description": "Generate and refactor code",
        "tags": ["coding", "typescript"]
      }
    ]
  },
  "server": {
    "port": 3000,
    "advertiseHost": "localhost"
  },
  "opencode": {
    "baseUrl": "http://localhost:4096",
    "projectDirectory": "/path/to/project",
    "model": "anthropic/claude-sonnet-4"
  },
  "features": {
    "autoApprovePermissions": true,
    "streamArtifactChunks": false
  },
  "timeouts": {
    "prompt": 600000
  }
}
```

Config layers merge in priority order: **defaults ← config file ← env vars ← CLI args**.

### Environment Variables

| Variable | Maps to |
|----------|---------|
| `OPENCODE_URL` | `opencode.baseUrl` |
| `OPENCODE_DIRECTORY` | `opencode.projectDirectory` |
| `OPENCODE_MODEL` | `opencode.model` |
| `OPENCODE_AGENT` | `opencode.agent` |
| `OPENAI_API_KEY` | `codex.apiKey` |
| `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` | `claude.apiKey` |

## Endpoints

| Method | Path | Description |
|--------|------|-------------|
| `GET` | `/health` | Health check |
| `GET` | `/.well-known/agent-card.json` | A2A Agent Card |
| `POST` | `/a2a/jsonrpc` | A2A JSON-RPC transport |
| `POST` | `/a2a/rest` | A2A REST transport |

## Programmatic API

```ts
import {
  createA2AServer,
  resolveConfig,
  registerExecutor,
  createOpenCodeExecutor,
  createCodexExecutor,
  createClaudeExecutor,
  SessionBindingStore,
} from '@axiom-lattice/cli-a2a';

// Register executors
registerExecutor('opencode', createOpenCodeExecutor);
registerExecutor('codex', createCodexExecutor);
registerExecutor('claude', createClaudeExecutor);

// Load config
const config = resolveConfig('agent-config.json');

// Start server
const server = await createA2AServer(config);

// Graceful shutdown
process.on('SIGINT', async () => {
  await server.shutdown();
  process.exit(0);
});
```

## Multi-Turn Conversations

The A2A protocol uses `contextId` to group messages into a single conversation.
`cli-a2a` maps each `contextId` to an underlying CLI session, enabling multi-turn
continuity across all three providers:

| Provider | New Session | Resume Session | Session ID Source |
|----------|-------------|----------------|-------------------|
| Codex | `codex exec --json <prompt>` | `codex exec resume <thread_id> <prompt>` | `thread_id` from JSONL `thread.started` event |
| Claude Code | `claude -p --session-id <uuid> <prompt>` | `claude -p --resume <uuid> <prompt>` | Generated UUID |
| OpenCode | `opencode run --format json <prompt>` | `opencode run --session <sessionID> <prompt>` | `sessionID` from JSON events |

**How it works:**
1. The A2A client sends a message with a `contextId`
2. `cli-a2a` looks up the `contextId` in the SessionBindingStore
3. If found: uses the provider's resume command to continue the CLI session
4. If not found: creates a new CLI session and saves the binding
5. Subsequent messages with the same `contextId` reuse the same CLI session

History is maintained by the underlying CLI tool — no prompt concatenation needed.

### Session Persistence

Bindings are persisted to disk so that `cli-a2a` restarts preserve conversations:

- **Default path**: `~/Library/Application Support/axiom-lattice/cli-a2a/sessions.json`
- **Format**: JSON array of `{ provider, contextId, sessionId, ... }`
- **TTL**: 24 hours by default (configurable via `session.ttl`)
- **Cleanup**: Expired bindings removed on load and periodically (every 1h)

To disable persistence:
```json
{
  "session": {
    "persist": false
  }
}
```

To disable session reuse entirely (each request creates a new session):
```json
{
  "session": {
    "reuseByContext": false
  }
}
```

### Session Config

```json
{
  "session": {
    "reuseByContext": true,
    "persist": true,
    "storePath": "~/custom/path/sessions.json",
    "ttl": 86400000,
    "cleanupInterval": 3600000
  }
}
```

| Field | Default | Description |
|-------|---------|-------------|
| `reuseByContext` | `true` | Map `contextId` to CLI session for multi-turn |
| `persist` | `true` | Save bindings to disk across restarts |
| `storePath` | `~/Library/Application Support/axiom-lattice/cli-a2a/sessions.json` | Custom binding store path |
| `ttl` | `86400000` (24h) | Session TTL in milliseconds |
| `cleanupInterval` | `3600000` (1h) | Cleanup interval in milliseconds |

## Architecture

```
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  cli-a2a (Express A2A Server)                        │
│                                                      │
│  ┌─────────────┐  ┌──────────┐  ┌──────────────────┐│
│  │ Agent Card  │  │ JSON-RPC │  │ REST             ││
│  └─────────────┘  └──────────┘  └──────────────────┘│
│                         │                            │
│  ┌──────────────────────▼───────────────────────────┐│
│  │  Executor Registry                                ││
│  │  ┌────────────┐ ┌─────────┐ ┌──────────────────┐ ││
│  │  │ OpenCode   │ │ Codex   │ │ Claude Code      │ ││
│  │  │ Executor   │ │ Executor│ │ Executor         │ ││
│  │  └─────┬──────┘ └────┬────┘ └───────┬──────────┘ ││
│  └────────┼─────────────┼──────────────┼────────────┘│
│           │             │              │              │
│  ┌────────▼─────────────▼──────────────▼────────────┐│
│  │  SessionBindingStore                              ││
│  │  contextId → CLI sessionId + file persistence     ││
│  └──────────────────────────────────────────────────┘│
└───────────┼─────────────┼──────────────┼─────────────┘
            │ HTTP        │ spawn        │ spawn
    ┌───────▼────────┐ ┌──▼───────┐ ┌───▼────────────┐
    │ opencode serve │ │ codex CLI│ │ claude CLI (-p) │
    └────────────────┘ └──────────┘ └────────────────┘
```

## Networking — Exposing to External Networks

The agent runs a local HTTP server. To reach it from outside, use the built-in
WebSocket bridge (no SSH tunnel or ngrok required).

### Built-in WebSocket Bridge (Recommended)

```bash
# Agent — opens outbound WebSocket to gateway
npx @axiom-lattice/cli-a2a \
  --provider opencode \
  --port 3001 \
  --bridge-url ws://gateway:8080/api/a2a/bridge \
  --bridge-key sk-xxx \
  --register-url http://gateway:8080 \
  --register-key sk-xxx
```

```
Internal Network (agent)           Public (gateway)
┌──────────────────┐              ┌─────────────────────┐
│ cli-a2a :3001    │──WebSocket──→│ /api/a2a/bridge     │
│   ↑              │   outbound   │   ↑                 │
│   │ local call   │              │   │ HTTP proxy      │
│   │              │              │ /api/a2a/bridge/    │
│ Express A2A      │              │   proxy/{agentId}/* │
│ OpenCode/Codex/  │              │                     │
│ Claude           │              │ A2A_REMOTE agent →  │
└──────────────────┘              └─────────────────────┘
```

**How it works:**
1. Agent opens an outbound WebSocket to gateway (outbound almost never blocked)
2. Gateway stores the connection keyed by agent ID
3. Gateway exposes `GET/POST /api/a2a/bridge/proxy/{agentId}/*`
4. When the orchestrator calls the proxy URL, gateway pushes the request over WebSocket
5. Agent makes a local HTTP call to its Express server, returns the response

The agent's `agentCardUrl` in registration points to
`http://gateway:8080/api/a2a/bridge/proxy/{agentId}/.well-known/agent-card.json`.

### SSH Reverse Tunnel (Alternative)

```bash
ssh -R 3001:localhost:3001 user@public-bastion.com -N &
npx cli-a2a --provider opencode --port 3001 \
  --advertise-host public-bastion.com \
  --register-url http://gateway:8080 --register-key sk-xxx
```

### Same Network

```bash
npx cli-a2a --provider opencode --port 3001 \
  --advertise-host 192.168.1.42 \
  --register-url http://gateway:8080 --register-key sk-xxx
```

## Multi-Project

Run multiple instances on different ports for different projects:

```bash
npx @axiom-lattice/cli-a2a --provider opencode -d /proj/frontend --port 3001 &
npx @axiom-lattice/cli-a2a --provider opencode -d /proj/backend  --port 3002 &
```

## Package Exports

| Export | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `createA2AServer(config)` | Start an Express A2A server |
| `resolveConfig(path?, overrides?)` | Merge config layers |
| `loadConfigFile(path)` | Read and parse a JSON config file |
| `registerExecutor(provider, factory)` | Register an executor factory |
| `createOpenCodeExecutor(config, store)` | Create an OpenCode executor |
| `createCodexExecutor(config, store)` | Create a Codex executor |
| `createClaudeExecutor(config, store)` | Create a Claude executor |
| `SessionBindingStore` | `contextId → sessionId` persistence |
| `generateContextId()` | Generate a new UUID contextId |
| `logger`, `LogLevel` | Structured logger |

### Patch Changes

- b928a17: Follow up the Wiz remediation with `pnpm audit`: bump the pinned transitive
  dependencies to the advisories published after the scan (shell-quote 1.11 —
  critical command injection — fastify 5.12.6, @fastify/busboy 3.2.2,
  @hono/node-server 2.1.3, brace-expansion 1.1.21/2.1.7/5.0.12,
  body-parser 1.20.9/2.4.0, decode-uri-component 0.5.1, fast-uri 3.1.9/4.2.3,
  glob 10.5/11.1/14.0.4, langsmith 0.12, picomatch 2.3.2/4.0.4,
  protobufjs 7.6.5/8.8.1, source-map-js 1.2.2, undici 7.30.1, sanitize-html
  2.18.1, tar 7.5.22, tmp 0.2.7, vite 6.4.5, yaml 2.9.1, ajv 6.14/8.18,
  mysql2 3.23.1, uuid 11.1, and others). Overrides are scoped per major line
  where different majors are both required, and none pins below a declaring
  package's range. Further zero-out pass: echarts 5.5 → 6.1 in react-sdk,
  katex 0.19.1 (the patched range starts at 0.18.2), glob 14.0.4 for every
  affected major line (10/11/13/14; glob 7 is outside the advisory range),
  minimatch 11.0.8 for every vulnerable line, rimraf 4/5 → 6.1.4 (drops the
  glob 9 dependency), ibm-cloud-sdk-core 5.9.4 (pulls file-type 21.3.4), and
  fast-xml-parser 5.12.0. The client-sdk build moves from tsup 6.7 to 8.5,
  clearing the last GHSA-3mv9-4h5g-vhg3 finding. Drop the unused `xlsx`
  dependency from `apps/web`, which has no patched npm release.

  Overrides only apply to this monorepo, so also raise the published packages'
  own dependency ranges to patched versions, otherwise downstream consumers
  (fina_demo) resolve the old lower bounds when they reinstall: fastify
  ^5.12.6 (gateway, microsandbox-service, opensandbox-gateway), react-router
  ^7.18.2, vite ^6.4.5, mysql2 ^3.23.1 (core), and uuid ^11.1.1 (core, gateway,
  pg-stores, react-sdk, and the cli-a2a peer range).

## 0.1.6

### Patch Changes

- 3a124ab: **BREAKING**: Remove `LocalA2ATemplateStore` from store lattice, replacing it with static template config.

  - Deleted `LocalA2ATemplateStoreProtocol` and all implementations (InMemory, PostgreSQL, SQLite)
  - Removed `localA2ATemplate` entry from `StoreTypeMap` and store lattice default registrations
  - Removed obsolete PostgreSQL Local A2A template migration source; existing database tables are not dropped
  - Removed `LocalA2ATemplateEntry`, `CreateLocalA2ATemplateRequest`, `UpdateLocalA2ATemplateRequest` types
  - `client.assistants.localA2A.templates` now only supports `.list()` (returns `LocalA2ATemplateDefinition[]`)
  - Templates are now defined in `packages/gateway/src/config/local-a2a-templates.ts`
  - Gateway resolves the managed CLI through the installed `@axiom-lattice/cli-a2a/cli-path` export and declares the CLI package as a runtime dependency
  - Templates no longer contain port or agentCardUrl; those are user-supplied at creation time
  - `CreateAssistantModal` appends the Agent Card URL port to template commands as `--port <port>` when the template does not already declare a port
  - CLI session files are isolated by provider and server port when no explicit store path is configured

- Updated dependencies [3a124ab]
  - @axiom-lattice/protocols@3.0.0
